story: Google Workspace receives the domain's mail and has a DKIM key in place to sign it. Six other services are set up to send as the domain: two transactional (Amazon SES, SendGrid), two support and CRM (Intercom, Zendesk), two commerce and apps (KnowBe4, Tipalti); three more are likely from a DKIM key name alone (Cloudflare Email Routing, Kit, Mandrill). DMARC reports go to Valimail. Not checked: the website (turned off), DKIM selectors past the first 27 on two subdomains, and the crt.sh certificate log (read only with --ct).
